basic_details.scholarship_name: UMass Amherst Manning CICS Graduate Assistantship & Fellowship
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Massachusetts Amherst (Manning College of Information and Computer Sciences - CICS)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Massachusetts Amherst Main Campus (Amherst, Massachusetts, USA)
degree_levels: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD in Computer Science)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted to doctoral candidates in Computer Science: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Information Retrieval & Search, Natural Language Processing, Computer Systems & Networking, Computer Vision, Robotics, and Theory of Computation.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: 100% of admitted PhD students receive guaranteed full financial support (~55 to 70 doctoral students admitted annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global merit competition; typically 3 to 6 high-achieving Pakistani graduates admitted per academic year
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Guaranteed 5-year full doctoral funding package (tuition waiver + academic-year stipend + summer stipend + health insurance)

nationality_requirements: Open to international and domestic applicants holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (BS) or Master's degree (MS) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or closely related field from an HEC-recognized university with high academic distinction (minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.75+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: UMass Graduate School minimum GPA is 3.0/4.0; CICS PhD admissions committee applies rigorous standards with competitive admitted GPA above 3.75.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial undergraduate coursework in algorithms, data structures, computer systems, operating systems, linear algebra, and discrete mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in the final year of undergraduate or master's study can apply; degree completion required before September matriculation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Publications in top computing conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, SIGIR, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR, OSDI, SIGCOMM) or open-source software contributions carry highest weight.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT min 80 (recommended 100+; speaking 26+ for TA certification) or IELTS Academic min 6.5 (speaking 7.0+ for TA), or Duolingo min 115. MOI certificates not accepted.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; diversity in computing initiatives actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Top applicants considered for Manning CICS Dean's Fellowships and Center for Intelligent Information Retrieval (CIIR) Fellowships.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: External fellowship holders receive institutional top-up awards.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition waiver covering 100% of international graduate tuition and curriculum fees (~USD 35,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: UMass Amherst Graduate School application fee of USD 85 paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: Paid from monthly assistantship stipend; off-campus student apartments in Amherst, Hadley, and Northampton average USD 700 to 1,000/month for shared housing.

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed annual assistantship stipend of USD 36,000 to USD 40,000 / year (~USD 3,000 to 3,333 / month; ~PKR 840,000 to 933,000 / month) provided via Graduate Research Assistantships (RA) and Teaching Assistantships (TA) under GEO union contract.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Boston Logan (BOS) / Bradley International (BDL) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: US F-1 Visa fee (USD 185) and SEVIS I-901 fee (USD 350) paid to US government.

health_insurance.details: Graduate Employee Organization (GEO) negotiated health insurance plan providing 95% subsidized medical, dental, and vision coverage (~USD 3,800 / year value).

food_allowance.details: Food and living subsistence covered comfortably by the monthly assistantship stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: High-performance GPU computing clusters, research lab hardware, and software licenses provided by CICS.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental and advisor travel funds cover registration, airfare, and hotel costs (USD 1,200 to 2,500 per conference) for presenting accepted papers at leading conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Pioneer Valley Transit Authority (PVTA) bus system is 100% fare-free throughout Amherst, Hadley, Northampton, and South Hadley.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single renowned public research university: University of Massachusetts Amherst (Amherst, MA, USA)
participating_institutions: UMass Amherst - Manning College of Information and Computer Sciences (CICS)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 20 global computer science program (CSRankings #18, US News CS #24); world-renowned pioneer in information retrieval, AI, natural language processing, and systems.

university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS or MS in CS/STEM with 3.5+ GPA, 3 letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, CV, and TOEFL 80+ (100+ recommended) or IELTS 6.5+. GRE is NOT required.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Information retrieval and AI/ML are globally renowned and attract heavy competition; systems, networking, theory, and databases offer comparatively higher admission chances for qualified applicants.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Review faculty directories at Manning CICS; specify 2-3 target research groups and cite their recent conference papers in your statement of purpose.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: UMass Amherst Graduate School Online Application System (Slate)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the UMass Slate graduate portal, select Computer Science (PhD), specify faculty research areas, and upload required application materials.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Research CICS faculty research groups and laboratories.
Step 2 (October - December): Create profile on the UMass Amherst Slate graduate portal.
Step 3 (November - December): Upload statement of purpose, CV, transcripts, and register 3 academic references.
Step 4 (By 15 December): Submit application and pay USD 85 application fee.
Step 5 (January - February): Faculty review applications and conduct virtual technical interviews.
Step 6 (February - March): Department issues official PhD admission offer letters with 5-year guaranteed funding package.
Step 7 (By 15 April): Confirm acceptance in the portal.
Step 8 (May - July): Receive Form I-20 and apply for US F-1 visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic funding: 100% of admitted PhD students are awarded 5-year full funding packages without a separate scholarship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Three academic recommendation letters submitted online via the Slate automated referee portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose: 2-page essay discussing research experience, technical interests, faculty alignment, and doctoral aspirations.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated into statement of purpose; focus on concrete research problems, past methodological contributions, and prospective research directions.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, open-source repositories, engineering projects, and technical skills.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Virtual technical interviews (30-45 minutes via Zoom) conducted by prospective faculty advisors evaluating research problem solving and mathematical intuition.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT (80+; 100+ recommended) or IELTS Academic (6.5+) or Duolingo (115+). GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Unofficial scans uploaded for review; official transcripts required upon admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for non-English credentials.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the UMass Amherst Slate portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: PDF scans of official transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate institutions attended.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS transcripts; official HEC attestation required only upon matriculation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 2-page statement of purpose articulating research questions, past projects, technical methodology, and why Manning CICS faculty are an ideal fit.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Focus on research depth and technical contributions rather than generic personal background.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Three confidential recommendation letters from professors or research scientists familiar with your creative research capacity.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure professors submit from verified university domain email addresses (.edu.pk).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive CV detailing academic history, research projects, technical skills, publications, and GitHub links.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly differentiate peer-reviewed publications, preprints, and coursework projects.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official TOEFL iBT (code 3917), IELTS Academic, or Duolingo score report taken within past 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Aim for TOEFL 100+ or IELTS 7.5+ to satisfy TA spoken English standards.

required_documents_checklist.specification: PDF copies of published papers or arXiv preprints demonstrating research depth.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Submitting first-author papers at top conferences significantly boosts admission probability.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Admissions offered for Fall semester only. Hard deadline is December 15.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 25% (GPA, difficulty of computer science coursework, mathematical foundations)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 5% (academic service, leadership, contributions to open-source computing)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (published research, statement of purpose, technical sophistication, code samples)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (industry research experience or software engineering roles)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (clarity of research goals and alignment with faculty mentors)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (credibility of referees and their specific evaluations of research aptitude)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (alignment with faculty grants and technical performance in video interview)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Manning CICS Doctoral Admissions Committee and faculty lab PIs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Faculty-led holistic review: Area committees review candidate dossiers, match candidates to funded faculty labs, and conduct interviews before issuing full funding offers.

competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, GIKI, and UET Lahore.

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial education recruiters charging large sums claiming guaranteed admission or funding at UMass Amherst. Admissions decisions are made exclusively by CICS faculty.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Pay the USD 85 application fee only through the official UMass Slate portal. Never wire money to intermediaries.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: UMass Amherst strictly forbids the use of admissions agents. Plagiarized statements of purpose result in immediate disqualification.
hidden_costs_breakdown: US F-1 Visa and SEVIS I-901 fees: USD 535 (~PKR 150,000).
Flight ticket from Pakistan to Boston: ~PKR 350,000 to 500,000.
Initial apartment security deposit and living costs: ~USD 1,500 (~PKR 420,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: GRE General Test is required. (FACT: The GRE is NOT required for CICS PhD applicants).

CLAIM: Living in Massachusetts is impossible on a graduate stipend. (FACT: Western Massachusetts / Pioneer Valley has far lower living costs than Boston, and the GEO contract guarantees generous stipends).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some online forums report that MS students receive automatic assistantships. At UMass Amherst, guaranteed multi-year assistantships are reserved almost exclusively for PhD students.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 or higher in all graduate coursework with satisfactory research progress.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research and academic residency on the Amherst campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews conducted by the doctoral program committee and faculty advisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Graduate research and teaching assistantships are capped at 20 hours per week during academic terms under GEO union contract.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates qualify for US F-1 OPT with 3-year STEM extension and employer-sponsored permanent residence pathways.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminates upon withdrawal; past disbursements are not subject to clawback.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Fellowships cannot be transferred to other universities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing research areas or advisors requires approval from the Graduate Program Director and finding a faculty member with research funding.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for 5 years; extensions into Year 6 are supported via faculty advisor research grants.
